mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% signals persistent monetary accommodation that lowers discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% indicates labor market distress that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 3-month moving averages signals strengthening consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 96.0) during late-cycle slowdowns indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 96.0 during late-cycle slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% triggers Federal Reserve tightening expectations that increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth (PAYEMS > 0.1% MoM) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 8.5%) indicate accelerating labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases >0.1% MoM and UNRATE < 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth (RSAFS > 0.5% MoM) during consumer spending regimes directly supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM.
